content.body:
The British Rifl-Grenadier is unique in that he is armed with the only anti-tank grenade in Battleground Europe. The No.68 Mills bomb was fired from a cup fitted to the end of a regular Lee Enfield rifle and employing a special high charge "blank" cartridge loaded into the breech.
While efective against tanks or armoured vehicles it did lose that effectiveness as armour became thicker later in the war, and required the rifleman to gain an almost ideal, perfect angle shot at 90 degree obliquety to the target, very difficult under most combat circumstances. for these reasons ... generally only the very skilled and careful rifle grenadiers do well against most tanks, and the HEAT properties of this grenade are not well suited against enemy infantry.
content.brief: Special Equipment: No.68 Mills Bomb HEAT (anti-armour) Explosive: 800g (each grenade) Range: 250m Included Weapons: Lee Enfield .303 Rifle 6 x HEAT grenades 1 x combat knife
content.title: GRENADIER INFANTRY
